children: Cleaning on a schedule, not a scramble

Grime, algae, gum and oil don’t take a season off — and chasing a different washer every time is how a property slips from sharp to shabby. A scheduled contract keeps it handled: we build a cadence around each surface and site, then simply show up.
One insured contract covers every location and every surface you own, with one crew and one point of contact. You approve the plan once; we keep it looking its best on a rhythm you can budget around.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A large commercial parking lot and multi-level garage from above

children: A crew lead walks your property with you — checking the facade material, glass, walkways, drains and lot — and flags what needs attention, what method it calls for, and how often it should be done to stay ahead of buildup.

You get a clear, written scope: the surfaces, the approach, the access and timing, and a price you can put in a budget. No jargon and no pressure — just a plan and honest numbers. The assessment is always free.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who ProWash Exterior Cleaning is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A clean commercial storefront and glass facade along a city block

children: We started ProWash because commercial properties deserve better than a washer who shows up once, leaves streaks, and never answers the phone again. A clean exterior is the first thing a customer sees — it should be handled by people who treat it like it matters.

We’re an insured, professional crew built for scheduled work: storefronts, building exteriors, lots, garages and fleets, kept sharp on a cadence you can rely on. One contract, one point of contact, and results you don’t have to chase.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every scope starts with a real walk-through of your property — the right method for each surface, never a template quote guessed from the curb.
Certificates of insurance, safe-access plans and water-reclamation compliance handled up front, so your risk and your legal team stay comfortable.
Recurring visits scheduled and reminded before each service — your property stays presentable without a single call from you.
